paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.4 as of the last update, with a change of -3.03% from the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions.

There are 2 new news items in the last 24 hours, both from Bloomberg, regarding Fermi Inc. receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador, a data center campus it is developing in west Texas. One of the news items provides a summary stating that the subpoena is for certain documents related to the project.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent SEC filings, including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026, with a disclosed annualized base salary and target annual bonus. There is also one Form 4 filing in the feed.
